about: Per-file wall-time budget for npm test (FRC70); docs/audits/TEST_SPEED_2026-11-10.md. scripts/test_budget_reporter.mjs warns, never fails, past default_ms or a file's entry. Entries are play-length files (tier slow): test:changed leaves them to the merge batch unless their own imports change. A new slow file speeds up its setup first and gets an entry only for real play. Budgets only ratchet down: npm run test:budget -- --tighten. suite_sum_ms is the total file time that triggers a re-profile at +25%.
